title: Provision kits distribution
summary: Renowned cricket coach Dinesh Lad, mentor to Rohit Sharma, actively trains underprivileged children to help them excel in inter-school competitions.
description:
Renowned cricket coach Dinesh Lad, mentor to Rohit Sharma, actively trains underprivileged children to help them excel in inter-school competitions.
Currently, he has taken 26 children under his wing for daily coaching sessions and has requested support in providing nutritional provision kits for them.
Distribution of Provision Kits at Borivali
* Date: October 29th
* Beneficiaries: 26
* Project Cost: Rs 13,000/-
